Messages.Body:
I'm sure there's a parallel with other cards but...

Do the discipline cards that are mentioned in the card text have to be
in your hand immediately after you have drawn to replace The Becoming
or can you play them one after another as you draw them after playing
them one at a time?

Hope the question makes sense :)

The Becoming [KoT:U]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
Capacity: 0
+1 stealth action. Requires a non-sterile vampire.
Put this card in play. It becomes a 0-capacity <non-unique> vampire of
the same clan as the acting vampire. Move up to 1 blood from the
acting vampire and up to 3 Discipline cards from your hand to this
vampire. This vampire cannot act this turn. If this vampire has no
capacity-increasing Discipline cards, burn him or her.

J
